description: Mount an ISO on the VPS (e.g. to install an own OS). Restart the VPS to boot from it. Requires confirm=true. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

applyHardwareProfile.description: Adapt the VM hardware to the ISO's OS (UEFI + TPM); default false. Set true for Windows 11 / UEFI-only ISOs.

attachDriverDisc.description: Attach the VirtIO driver disc (Windows installs).

bootFromIso.description: Boot from the ISO first; default true except driver/tool ISOs.

serviceId.description: ID of the VPS: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_vservers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

volid.description: Alternative to isoId: the image's `volid` from list_vserver_isos.

name: mount_vserver_iso
title: Mount ISO on VPS
